messages:
jamie: FYI I hit a parity/param-drift bug between REST and the node-sdk while running the onboarding sample app. REST has a query param `wait=true` on POST /v1/jobs that blocks until completion. node-sdk users expect `waitFor` option on the method to do the same, but our SDK currently sends it in the JSON body (and REST ignores it), so the SDK returns immediately instead of the final result. CI flakes. repro below.

jamie: curl (blocking, works)
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/jobs?wait=true' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"summarizer-compact","input":"long doc"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# -> { "job_id": "j123", "status": "completed", "result": {...} }
```

jamie: node-sdk (non-blocking, broken)
```
// sampleapp uses this:
const job = await client.jobs.create({ model: 'summarizer-compact', input: 'long doc', waitFor: true })
// what we actually get back currently:
// { id: 'j124', status: 'pending' }
// the SDK sent { waitFor: true } in the POST body, but the server expects ?wait=true as a query param
```

rachel: ouch. that explains flakiness in onboarding e2e where we assert final output. is this a recent regression or always been like this?

jamie: I think it slipped when the node client method signature was refactored to accept options object; we added `waitFor` but only serialize body fields. earlier we had explicit query param plumbing for a couple endpoints but not this one.

mark: thanks for the repro. quick fix is to map `waitFor` -> query param `wait=true` in jobs.create wrapper. two spots to check: the high-level JS method and the generated types for TS. also add a unit test that verifies query string built when waitFor true.

priyanka: can we also make the SDK accept either `waitFor` or `wait` to be more forgiving? customers often copy curl examples with `wait=true`. Also add a small note in the onboarding sampleapp README clarifying the difference.

mark: agree on being permissive. plan: 1) map waitFor and wait to the query param (priority bugfix), 2) unit + integration test that stubs endpoint and asserts blocking behavior, 3) add e2e step in sampleapp CI to assert final result instead of pending, 4) release patch (node-sdk 0.9.3).

rachel: also search other job-like endpoints for similar param drift (e.g., /v1/embeddings/async had earlier issues). could be a systematic gap in our param handling layer.

jamie: good call. I can run a quick grep across sdk codegen templates for `query` vs `body` mapping.

devex-bot: Created issue #3722: "node-sdk: map waitFor/wait option to ?wait=true query param for POST /v1/jobs to restore blocking behavior in SDK" assigned to mark, priority: medium. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3722 :white_check_mark: 

priyanka: one more note for the release changelog: call out that previous SDK versions may return pending job objects when callers expected synchronous results; customers using onboarding sample will need patch. I'll prep a short blurb for support.

mark: opening PR with mapping + tests now, will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
